en.headline: Woman, 63, dies after concrete mixer hits pedestrian in Kam Tin
en.dek: The victim, struck on Kam Tin Road near Ko Po Tsuen at about 8.30am, was taken first to Pok Oi Hospital and later to Tuen Mun Hospital, where she was certified dead in the early afternoon.
body: A 63-year-old woman has died after being struck by a concrete mixer truck on Kam Tin Road in Pat Heung, Yuen Long, on Wednesday morning, police and local media reported.

The collision occurred at about 8.31am near a pedestrian crossing by Ko Po Tsuen, close to the junction with Tsing Long Highway. The heavy vehicle was travelling along the slow lane towards Pat Heung when it hit the woman as she crossed the road.

She was initially taken unconscious to Pok Oi Hospital and later transferred to Tuen Mun Hospital, where she was certified dead at about 1.39pm. The 55-year-old male driver remained at the scene to assist officers. One shoe was left at the crossing.

According to accounts given at the scene, the driver said the vehicle had a green light and that the pedestrian stepped out from the right. Police are investigating the cause of the accident and have not released a formal finding on fault.

zh.headline: 錦田公路混凝土車撞斃六旬婦 下午不治
zh.dek: 63歲女子今早約7時半在錦田公路近高埔村被運載混凝土重型貨車撞倒，先送博愛醫院再轉屯門醫院，下午約1時39分不治。
body: 元朗八鄉錦田公路周三早上發生致命交通意外，一名63歲女子被運載混凝土的重型貨車撞倒後不治。
警方指意外約於8時31分發生，事發地點為錦田公路近高埔村行人過路處、靠近青朗公路交界。貨車當時沿慢線往八鄉方向行駛，撞到過路女子。
女事主昏迷被送往博愛醫院，其後轉送屯門醫院搶救，延至下午約1時39分證實不治。55歲男司機在場協助調查。現場遺下一隻鞋。
據報道，司機向警員表示當時沿綠燈行駛，途人由右至左橫過馬路。警方正調查意外原因，暫未公布正式責任劃分。
